title: Biologically and chemically synthesized ZnO nanoparticles for textile wastewater treatment and phytotoxicity alleviation in Vigna radiata
content:
Environ. Sci.: Adv., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6VA00120C, Paper

Fatima Batool, Muhammad Zubair, Faisal Mahmood, Muhammad Shahid, Tanvir Shahzad, Weitao Liu, Sabir Hussain, Aman Ullah
This study reports the development of biologically and chemically synthesized ZnO-NPs using a leaf extract of Conocarpus erectus and sodium hydroxide, respectively, for wastewater treatment and phytotoxicity alleviation in Vigna radiata.
